uniqueness_check.method: Repository scan for the slug aurelia-aurita-turing-wavelength-s0 across models/, datasets/, morphoeval/lean/loops/, morphoeval/math_kg_loops/, and morphoeval/audits/. scout_literature.py --slot 3129 is not in morphoeval/cloud/campaign_100_slots.yaml (slots 1-100 only), so the slot loader was not used.

neighbor_not_copied.note: A different Aurelia Turing slot already has a math-kg stub. This loop does not edit it and does not reuse its parameters or its placeholder DOI.

scale_note: OpenAlex does not return a paper that measures an Aurelia pigment-stripe wavelength of 201 µm. That length is the assigned MorphoEval detail scale (0.0002006 m, tier 5_primordium_100um). The script calibrates k_c so the Schnakenberg wavelength equals this length, and says so in the claim boundary.
